fixtures.title: Release measurements with confirmed and unknown causes

fixtures.source: On 2026-07-14, Acme API v3.8.2 processed 48,120 requests. The error rate fell from 2.4% to 0.7% after the cache TTL changed from 5 to 15 minutes. allowed_claims.description: Acme API v3.8.2 processed 48,120 requests on 2026-07-14.

The remaining failures have no confirmed cause.

forbidden_claims.description: The TTL change is a confirmed cause of the lower error rate.

invariants.description: Preserve the supported 100-500 ms range.
